review_candidates.title: Technical Support Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: This role suits someone who enjoys solving problems, communicating clearly, and working across both technical and customer-facing responsibilities. What You'll Do Troubleshoot and resolve technical issues reported by customers via email, chat, or ticketing systems Reproduce bugs, investigate root causes, and escalate to engineering with clear, detailed reports Monitor system performance and proactively flag potential issues Write and maintain internal documentation, FAQs, and troubleshooting gui
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: What We're Looking For 3+ years of experience in a technical support, application support, or related engineering role Strong understanding of web technologies (APIs, databases, networking basics) Familiarity with SQL and at least one scripting/programming language (Python, JavaScript, etc.) Experience with ticketing/support tools (e.g., Zendesk, Jira, Freshdesk) Excellent written and verbal communication skills Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
